_about: V-I18N (conductor@, 2026-11-17, from Dinis ~22:50 UTC, board/BRIEF.md). The ten locales. en-GB is the source and lives at /. Every other locale has content/<dir>/ mirroring content/ and lives at /<dir>/. Seven languages; pt, fr and es each in two variants. de-DE, zh-CN and ja-JP are the conductor's proposal, which Dinis may swap. A page without a translation falls back to the English page, with a note, noindex.
_desc_range: Link-preview descriptions are 110 to 150 characters in the Latin-script locales. zh-CN and ja-JP carry about three times the meaning per character, so their range is 40 to 90 (a proposal; conductor@ to confirm).
